note: California State Parks redwood campground in Anderson Valley off Philo-Greenwood Rd, ~8 mi from Boonville, in the woods between the Big Hendy and Little Hendy groves; the Navarro River runs through the park. Two loops, Azalea and Wildcat; back-in pads 20-35 ft, so check the pad length when booking. Early-morning farm noise and spraying next to the park at times. --Claude
summary: Hendy Woods SP: $45 (+$8.25 RC fee), 92 sites in Azalea/Wildcat, back-in pads 20-35 ft (site length 35), no hookups, 1-7 nights, showers/dump/water; year-round with Azalea closed in winter; phone flagged.
